methods.name: GetService
methods.doc: The service of this class, made when the place lacks it. A name that is not a service class raises RE9001.

methods.name: FindService
methods.doc: The service of this class, or nil when the place lacks it.

classes.name: WorldRoot
classes.doc: A model that holds a simulated 3D world.

classes.name: Workspace
classes.note: Only the tree; physics and rendering properties come with their work packages.
classes.doc: The 3D world of the place: what is under it is simulated and drawn. Reached as the global workspace.

classes.name: ReplicatedStorage
classes.doc: A container both contexts can read.

classes.name: ServerScriptService
classes.doc: Holds the scripts that run on the server.

classes.name: ServerStorage
classes.doc: A container only the server reads.

classes.name: Lighting
classes.note: Only the tree; lighting properties come with the rendering work.
classes.doc: The place's lighting settings and sky.

classes.name: StarterPlayer
classes.doc: Settings and scripts given to each player. Holds StarterPlayerScripts and StarterCharacterScripts.

classes.name: StarterPlayerScripts
classes.doc: Scripts copied to each player when they join.

classes.name: StarterCharacterScripts
classes.doc: Scripts copied into each character when it spawns.

classes.name: BasePlayerGui
classes.doc: The base of the containers for screen interfaces.

classes.name: StarterGui
classes.note: Only the tree; screen interface behaviour comes with the UI work.
classes.doc: Screen interfaces copied to each player.

classes.name: CollectionService
classes.doc: Finds instances by tag and tells scripts when a tag is added or removed.

methods.name: AddTag
methods.doc: Adds a tag to an instance.

methods.name: RemoveTag
methods.doc: Removes a tag from an instance.

methods.name: HasTag
methods.doc: True if the instance has the tag.

methods.name: GetTagged
methods.doc: Every instance in the data model with the tag.

methods.name: GetInstanceAddedSignal
methods.doc: A signal that fires with each instance that gets the tag.

methods.name: GetInstanceRemovedSignal
methods.doc: A signal that fires with each instance that loses the tag.
